title_i18n.zh-CN: X 帖子意图标注插件

entries.author: yishan
entries.summary: A Chrome extension that labels posts in an X timeline with their intent and probability as you scroll, drawn as a tag directly after each post's timestamp. Categories include inducement, provocation, promotion, machine-generated, persuasion, entertainment and information. A side panel reports session counts (seen, judged, correct) and cumulative token cost. The author reports near-instant responses and usable accuracy before any tuning.

summary_i18n.en: A Chrome extension that labels posts in an X timeline with their intent and probability as you scroll, drawn as a tag directly after each post's timestamp. Categories include inducement, provocation, promotion, machine-generated, persuasion, entertainment and information. A side panel reports session counts (seen, judged, correct) and cumulative token cost. The author reports near-instant responses and usable accuracy before any tuning.
summary_i18n.zh-CN: 一个 Chrome 插件，在你滚动 X 时间线时实时标注每篇帖子的意图与概率，并把结果以标签形式画在帖子时间戳之后。类别包括诱导、挑拨、推销、机器生成、说服、娱乐、告知。右侧面板汇报本次会话的统计（总计 / 跳过 / 看过 / 判定 / 对了 / 失败）与累计 Token 花费。作者称几乎秒级响应，且在未细调的情况下分类已相当准。

notes_i18n.en: Worth reading as a latency argument rather than an accuracy one: labelling a timeline only works if the decision costs less than the scroll, which is the constraint a generative model cannot meet.
notes_i18n.zh-CN: 它的价值不在准确率而在延迟论证：要让「滚动时逐条标注」成立，单次判断必须比滚动本身更便宜——这正是生成式模型无法满足的约束。
